For financials specifically, sustained higher-for-longer rates and geopolitical uncertainty pressure loan growth expectations and capital markets activity. This is NOT a clean risk-on backdrop for large-cap banks. 2. RELATIVE STRENGTH: BAC is showing short-term underperformance. Daily ROC 5d: -0.84%, 10d: -3.26% — lagging in a mixed market. CAPITAL PRESERVATION FLAGS: The prior wiki thesis about Iran peace talks has been explicitly falsified — Iran-US military escalation has returned and intensified. The macro backdrop that sank the prior long thesis is still in effect and has worsened (UAE now targeted). The lessons table shows the only recorded trade was a stop-out (EMA pullback Fib dip-buy NVDA). Holding the existing position is separate from adding conviction; this analysis will not add to a position in a deteriorating macro environment without clean 2:1+ R/R. Verdict: pass on asymmetry. The directional setup is neither cleanly bullish (macro headwinds, short-term momentum negative, R/R sub-2:1) nor cleanly bearish (long-term uptrend intact, hourly stabilization, strong 51.83 support). NEUTRAL.

GS.reasoning: 1. MACRO REGIME: Same mixed-to-cautiously-bullish regime with active geopolitical left-tail. The Fed hawkish transition (Warsh, May 15) is an additional headwind — GS revenues are highly sensitive to capital markets cycle which benefits from rate cut expectations. This is a poor macro backdrop for investment banking. 2. RELATIVE STRENGTH: GS is underperforming on every short-term timeframe.
